第二十二章 断骨粹玉膏（第1页）
当冯斗拿出这一棵五千年的万花藤时，包括在荼姚都已经眼红的，因为对于这个级别的药材，就算荼姚这种属于天之骄子都会分外眼红的。
因为属于民级丹药师之中算得上顶级的存在，然而冯斗此时才算得上高级丹药师，离民级丹药师还是有一大段距离，正是因为这样就更加让荼姚眼红不已。
他将那棵万花藤投入了药鼎之中，原本药鼎之中就已经有四股药水不断翻滚，不断地围着那棵万花藤旋转。
仿佛要一下子将那棵万花藤炼化掉了一样的，可是万花藤并不是冯斗之前的四股药水想炼化就可以炼化的，毕竟这棵万花藤时属于五千年的药材。
然而此时的众人纷纷都被冯斗吸引住了，荼姚此时不由得暗中通知自己家族之中的长老，她暗道：“俊叔，通知一下家里族长，看看接下来族长有什么样的安排？”
其实荼姚对于冯斗还是非常之顾忌的，因为她对于冯斗并不了解，但是以此同时，她担心冯斗来自一些隐世的大家族，一旦得罪了这些家族，就相当于说为自己的家族带来绝对的危害。
她也不敢赌，她只能够让那个被他称为“俊叔”的人通知族长，并且让族长做出选择，这样不会因此而造成很大的危害。
荼解此时也开始炼制一颗高级丹药，这一颗丹药算得上高级丹药之中极品，这样也算是此次大赛之中能够达到了夺冠的资本。
这个也是为什么荼姚那么坚定地认为这次冠军是他们她家的，至于其他人都慢慢地有人因为丹药炼胡而退出比赛，因为高级丹药炼制都不是每一次都能够成功，有一个成功率的，越高级的丹药那么就越容易出现失败。
不过由于众人的炼丹经验还是比较短的，以此同时正是遇事处理不惊的心态缺陷，断定了越来越多人以失败收尾的，同时当然也有人在失败的第一次之后，果断地退而求其次地炼制着一些简单的初阶高级丹药，就是为了能够在得到初级大赛的名次。
毕竟初级大赛的奖励实在太诱人啦！所以众人不由得采用一些不太光彩的手段，当然很多人宁愿一搏也不愿意这样做的，就算是拥有非常之丰厚的奖励。
此时在场的人只有七个人留下来了，除了十二个人已经炼制好高级丹药，基本上这些人都已经内定好前十九名啦！
他们的最终排名则是由眼前的七个人来决定了，此时其中的一个人，大叫一声“起！”一个药鼎飞出来，不由得吸引着众人的眼神。
荼姚笑道：“看来此次要诞生一颗极品高级丹药了，还有可能会出现丹云呢？”
丹云属于高级以上的丹药才会遇到的一种现象，但是丹云却不是你想要就可以找到的，可以说一万次炼丹都不可能有一次的，当然一旦能够出现丹云的丹药绝对是价值惊人的，有丹云的丹药要比没有丹云的丹药价值要超过百倍都不止的。
所以众人一听到了荼姚说能够炼制出丹云的丹药，众人不由得眼睛泛光的，因为这个就已经代表此人绝对会进入前五名的，正是因为这样就更加吸引众人的注意力。
此时天空之中的云彩不断地快速翻动，开始有凝结的现象，这时已经算得上极点之所，天空之中的云彩加速凝结。
随着焦伢的话，天空之中的丹云由白色变成红色，一下子就已经让众人大吃一惊。
丹云只是最基本的丹药异境而已，丹药越高级就越有厉害，丹云之后就是丹雨，同样丹雨之后就是丹雷，当然丹雷只有帝级丹药才有可能出现，正是因为这样就更加难得啦！
可是现在出现丹云，马上吸引了不少大家族的人过来参观，因为能够在高级丹药师炼制出丹云的丹药，就证明他的前途将不可限量的。

Chapter 22 Jade Cream for Broken Bones (Page 1)
When Feng Dou took out this five-thousand-year-old Ten Thousand Flower Vine, everyone including Tu Yao was already jealous, because even a proud man like Tu Yao would be extremely jealous of medicinal materials of this level.
Because he is considered a top-level existence among the civilian-level alchemists, but Feng Dou is only considered a senior alchemist at this time, and he is still far away from the civilian-level alchemist. It is precisely because of this that Tu Yao is even more jealous.
He put the Ten Thousand Flower Vine into the medicine cauldron. There were already four streams of potion rolling around in the medicine cauldron, constantly rotating around the Ten Thousand Flower Vine.
It was as if the Ten Thousand Flower Vine was being refined all at once, but the Ten Thousand Flower Vine was not something that Feng Dou could refine just by refining the previous four potions. After all, the Ten Thousand Flower Vine was a five-thousand-year-old medicinal material.
However, everyone at this time was attracted by Feng Dou. Tu Yao could not help but secretly inform the elders in her family. She secretly said: "Uncle Jun, inform the patriarch of the family and see what arrangements the patriarch has next?"
In fact, Tu Yao is still very wary of Feng Dou because she doesn't know Feng Dou well. However, at the same time, she is worried that Feng Dou comes from some big hidden families. Once she offends these families, it will be equivalent to bringing absolute harm to her own family.
She didn't dare to bet. She could only ask the person he called "Uncle Jun" to inform the clan leader and let the clan leader make a choice, so that it would not cause great harm.
At this time, Tujie also began to refine a high-level elixir. This elixir was considered to be the best among high-level elixirs. This could be regarded as the capital to win the championship in this competition.
This is why Tu Yao is so firm that the championship this time belongs to her family. As for the others, some people are slowly withdrawing from the competition because of the elixir refining, because the refining of high-level elixirs is not successful every time. There is a success rate. The more advanced elixirs, the more likely they are to fail.
However, because everyone's experience in alchemy is still relatively short, and at the same time, it is the mental flaw of not being alarmed when encountering problems, which determines that more and more people end up in failure. At the same time, of course, there are also people who decisively retreat to the second best after the first failure and refine some simple elementary and advanced elixirs, just to get the ranking in the elementary competition.
After all, the rewards of the Junior Competition are so tempting! So everyone couldn't help but use some less-than-glorious methods. Of course, many people would rather take a chance than do this, even if they have very generous rewards.
At this time, there are only seven people present. Except for the twelve people who have already refined high-level elixirs, basically these people have already decided on the top nineteen!
Their final ranking was determined by the seven people in front of them. At this time, one of them shouted "Get up!" A medicinal cauldron flew out, attracting everyone's attention.
Tu Yao smiled and said: "It seems that a top-grade high-level elixir is going to be born this time. Is there also a possibility of an elixir cloud appearing?"
Danyun is a phenomenon that only high-level elixirs will encounter, but Danyun is not something you can find just by looking for it. It can be said that you will never find it once in 10,000 times of elixir refining. Of course, once Danyun appears, the value of the elixir is absolutely astonishing. The value of Danyun with Danyun is more than a hundred times higher than that without Danyun.
So when everyone heard that Tu Yao said that he could refine Danyun's elixir, everyone's eyes couldn't help but shine, because this already meant that this person would definitely enter the top five, and it was precisely because of this that it attracted everyone's attention even more.
At this time, the clouds in the sky were constantly turning rapidly and began to condense. This was already considered the extreme point, and the clouds in the sky were condensing at an accelerated rate.
Following Jiao You's words, the red clouds in the sky turned from white to red, which surprised everyone.
Danyun is just the most basic alchemy realm. The higher the level of the elixir, the more powerful it is. After the Danyun comes Danyu, and similarly after Danyu comes Danlei. Of course, Danlei can only appear with Emperor-level elixirs, which makes it even more rare!
But now that Danyun appeared, it immediately attracted many people from big families to visit, because being able to refine Danyun's elixir at the senior elixir master proved that his future would be limitless.
